title: AIsolate audit event
description: One line of the audit trail (AuditEvent, AuditLog): one per exchange and one per refused request. Every field is always present, null or [] when it has nothing; keys in exactly this order on the wire: ts, event, trace_id, space, airlock, revision, user, client, question, answer, outcome, reason, tools, evidence, verifiers, figures, grounding, model, duration_ms. Written compact, one JSON object per line, nothing before it, on the logger aisolate.audit (stdout) and POSTed as the request body to the ingest. Field meanings: docs/security.md, Audit trail.

ts.description: When the exchange began (admission start), UTC, truncated to the millisecond, ISO-8601 as java.time.Instant prints it: '2026-10-16T20:15:30.123Z', '2026-10-16T20:15:30.100Z', and with no fraction when the millisecond is 0: '2026-10-16T20:15:30Z'.

trace_id.description: The exchange's root span's trace id; null only where nothing traces.

user.description: The token's email claim as sent (case kept); its sub when the token has none (a machine client).

answer.description: The answer chunks concatenated; null when the model never answered. An error after partial chunks keeps them.

tools.description: One per tool call the model made, in call order. All but name, data_source and error are null when the call produced no evidence (failed).

args.description: The arguments as the model wrote them, once the tool server ran them.

rule_version.description: The revision of the policy the tool server applied; '' for a call that pinned no served policy.

sql_hash.description: First 12 hex digits of sha256 of the statement; '' when nothing ran.

error.description: Null when the call returned evidence; else its data source refused the login, could not be reached, or anything else failed.

evidence.description: The evidence ids the answer cites (its sourced/computed figures, sourced tables, quoted quotes, and any [ev-n] its text names), in the order the exchange produced them.

grounding.description: The chat answer's segments, figures, tables and quotes (docs/api.md), with every key named value, subject, period or unit removed at any depth (cases/audit/grounding-strip.json).

provider.description: The provider id the airlock names its model by.

calls.description: Model calls, a failed one included.

input_tokens.description: Summed over the calls; null when the provider reported none.
